content: We perform joint updates on $(\alpha , \beta , \lambda )$, where $\beta $ and $\lambda $ are updated via standard gradient computations, while $\alpha $ uses an unbiased, stochastic gradient estimate where we approximate the expectation in Eq (DISPLAY_FORM9). We use a single sample from $q_{\alpha }(z\mid x)$ and moving-average of rewards as a baseline to reduce variance.
